competitors.title: 1/ AllScale isn’t just another crypto payment tool. it’s building a self-custody stablecoin neobank
competitors.description:
1/ AllScale isn’t just another crypto payment tool. it’s building a self-custody stablecoin neobank designed for the global, internet-native economy.

In a world where work is borderless but money isn’t, AllScale is targeting the friction between the two.

2/ Today, cross-border payments are broken.

Freelancers wait days. Businesses pay high fees. Banks add friction, delays, and restrictions.

AllScale’s thesis is simple:
→ Payments should be instant
→ Global by default
→ And owned by the user

3/ At its core, AllScale is a non-custodial financial platform.

Users can:
– Send & receive payments globally
– Hold stablecoins directly
– Operate without traditional banks

All while maintaining full control of funds.

4/ This is where it gets interesting:

AllScale removes one of crypto’s biggest barriers  complexity.

No seed phrases. No friction-heavy onboarding.
Instead, it uses account abstraction and modern UX to make crypto feel invisible.

5/ The product stack is built around real-world utility:

– Invoicing (get paid globally in minutes)
– Payroll (pay teams across countries instantly)
– Social commerce (monetize directly from audience)

This isn’t theory. it’s operational finance.

6/ The bigger vision?

AllScale is building the “last-mile infrastructure” for stablecoins.

Stablecoins already solve volatility.
AllScale solves usability.

It connects:
→ Users
→ Payments
→ Compliance
→ Liquidity

Into one system.

7/ One of the strongest angles is self-custody + compliance.

Users control funds
But the system still integrates:
– KYC/KYB
– AML checks
– Regulatory alignment

A rare balance between freedom and compliance.

8/ The target market is massive:

– Freelancers
– DAOs
– Remote teams
– SMEs

Especially the unbanked and underbanked, where traditional finance fails.

9/ This aligns perfectly with a major macro trend:

The rise of the “internet worker” or “super individual” 
people earning globally but stuck with local financial rails.

AllScale is building for them.

10/ Another key layer: instant settlement

No waiting days.
No intermediaries.
Funds move in seconds using stablecoins.

This dramatically improves:
– Cash flow
– Business efficiency
– Financial access

11/ The market is paying attention.

AllScale raised $5M seed funding, backed by strong investors  signaling confidence in its vision to modernize global payments.

12/ But the real edge is positioning.

AllScale isn’t competing with banks.
It’s replacing the need for them at least for global payments.

13/ Of course, execution is everything.

Challenges include:
– Regulatory environments
– User trust
– Scaling infrastructure globally

But the problem it’s solving is undeniable.

14/ The thesis is clear:

Crypto solved value transfer.
Stablecoins solved volatility.

AllScale is solving usability.

15/ This isn’t just a payment app.

It’s a financial operating system for the global digital economy. where anyone, anywhere, can earn, send, and scale without borders.

And that’s where the next wave of adoption will come from.
@Allscaleio @sly_0100

1⃣ Overview

  DashX is a project foc
clients.description:
DashX – A Crucial Payment Piece in the @SeismicSys  Ecosystem

1⃣ Overview

  DashX is a project focused on building cross-border payment infrastructure using crypto.

Instead of pursuing DeFi or NFTs like many other projects, @DashXHQ  chooses a much more practical market: International payments - where trillions of USD worth of money flow annually.

2⃣What problem is DashX solving?

 Traditional System:
+ International money transfers take 2–5 days
+ High fees (3–10%)
+ Dependent on multiple intermediaries (banks, SWIFT)

 DashX Solution:
+ Uses crypto + blockchain
+ Transactions are almost:
  • Instant
  • Low fees
  • Few intermediaries

3⃣ DashX's Role in Seismic

The most important point: DashX does not exist independently, but is built on the Seismic platform.

 Clear Roles:
+ Seismic: Blockchain platform, Transaction processing, Ensuring speed & scalability
+ DashX: Application Layer, Bringing blockchain to real-world use cases: payments

 Real-world use case (US ↔ India)

A typical example DashX provides:
+ Sending money from the US to India
+ Payments between businesses in two countries
+ Remittances (Remittance)

This is one of the largest corridors in the world.

 Significance: If DashX captures this market, it will create enormous trading volume for Seismic.

4⃣Why is DashX important?

1. Bringing about “real adoption”

Most current blockchains: many “farm” users, few real users

 DashX is different:
+ addresses real-world needs
+ can attract: individuals (sending money), businesses (international payments)

2. Creating cash flow & activity for the system

DashX can become:
+ a source of transaction volume
+ a key driver for:
  • fees
  • network usage
  • ecosystem growth

➡️ This is a crucial factor for a new blockchain like Seismic

3. Market positioning

DashX is following the narrative of major players like Ripple (XRP) and Stellar (XLM)

But its potential advantages include:
• building from scratch -> more flexibility
• leveraging Seismic's tech stack
• easier optimization for scale & UX

@NoxxW3 
@xealistt 
@heathcliff_eth 
@2imtunek 
@thoai6sixx

Aave DAO approves $25M to boost protocol development

Aave (@aave) DAO has approved a $25 million stablecoin grant along with 75,000 $AAVE tokens to Aave Labs.

The proposal passed with around 75% support from token holders. Voting required staked AAVE participation, reinforcing strong community backing.

The move is tied to the “Aave Will Win” strategy for long term growth.

Per reports, this funding provides both operational stability and strengthens token dynamics.
